chapters/ch3.1:
The promised date day.
Heesu dragged Oppa by the hand to Sajik Ballpark.
chapters/ch3.2:
Today I'm the one who decides!!
Let's go cheer for Lotte!
chapters/ch3.3: Baseball…? I don't really know the rules….
chapters/ch3.4:
It's fine, I'll teach you everything.
But if you don't cheer… you know, right?
chapters/ch3.6: But the line at the ticket booth is wriggling suspiciously…!
chapters/ch3.7: Scuse me~ I was here the whole time~
chapters/ch3.8:
WHAT?????!!!!!!
Did you just cut in line?!
chapters/ch3.9: …Do you know how long I waited for tickets? Move.
chapters/ch3.10: Finally inside! The food zone smelled like fried chicken.
chapters/ch3.11: Babe, just one chicken… no, make it two.
chapters/ch3.12: The game's starting and all you can think about is food?
chapters/ch3.13: I heard you come to ballparks to eat, though…?
chapters/ch3.15: Just then, the chicken boxes flapped their wings and took off!
chapters/ch3.16:
If you keep chasing food around,
we are DONE today.
chapters/ch3.17: At last, the 1st-base cheering section. The game is on!
chapters/ch3.18: So what inning is it? Where'd the ball go?
chapters/ch3.20: CRACK—!! Right then, the other team hit a home run.
chapters/ch3.22: Heesu's Menhera gauge is filling up…
chapters/ch3.24:
Oppa. If you don't start yelling right now,
you're going home alone. Those tickets weren't cheap.
chapters/ch3.26: Then the rival cheer squad charged in with thundersticks!
chapters/ch3.27:
Bottom of the 9th. Down by one run…
and the sky turned pitch black.
chapters/ch3.28:
KRA-KOOM!! Today's game is…
RAINED OUT~!
chapters/ch3.29:
WHAT?????!!!!!!
It's the bottom of the 9th?!
chapters/ch3.30: Babe… it's raining, maybe we just go home…?
chapters/ch3.31:
Oppa, hold the umbrella.
I'll go clear away that cloud.
chapters/ch3.32:
The storm cloud lifted and the game resumed.
Bottom of the 9th, two outs, runner on second…
chapters/ch3.33:
CRACK—!!! A walk-off, go-ahead hit!!
Sajik went wild!
chapters/ch3.35: WE WON!!! Oppa did you see?! DID YOU SEE?!
chapters/ch3.37:
Still… seeing you this happy
makes me happy too.
chapters/ch3.38: …Hmph. Then we're coming together next time too, okay?
chapters/ch3.39:
Yeah. But babe… next time
at the fishing pier, there's something I have to tell you.
chapters/ch3.64: I was here first, wasn't I?
chapters/ch3.65: Why is this line so long!
chapters/ch3.77: A bat charged with two-out, bottom-of-the-9th energy
chapters/ch3.79: The number is Oppa's birthday. The name is Heesu
chapters/ch3.81: A brim that could block a foul ball
chapters/ch3.83: Steal to the ticket line like stealing a base
chapters/ch3.85: Packed with thundersticks, plastic bags and snacks
chapters/ch3.87: Today Bori is a die-hard fan too
chapters/ch3.89: The walk-off home run ball (Oppa insists)
chapters/ch3.105:
Bottom-of-the-9th comebacks: 1
{lv}

Oppa has something to tell her at the fishing pier…!
